controls.name: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
controls.description: Enforces a second authentication factor (push, FIDO2, TOTP) for user and admin sign-ins, blocking the vast majority of credential-stuffing, password-spray, and phishing-based account takeover attacks.
sources: Microsoft Identity Security Report: MFA blocks over 99.9% of automated account compromise attacks
CISA Multi-Factor Authentication Guidance (2022): MFA makes users 99% less likely to be hacked
Verizon DBIR 2024: 68% of breaches involve a non-malicious human element, with stolen credentials the top initial action

controls.name: Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR)
controls.description: Continuously monitors endpoints for malicious behavior, isolates compromised hosts, and shortens attacker dwell time through automated detection and response workflows.
sources: Ponemon Institute / IBM Cost of a Data Breach Report 2024: organizations using EDR/XDR reduced average breach cost by USD 1.9M (~30-40% lower than peers)
MITRE Engenuity ATT&CK Evaluations: leading EDR tools detect 85-95% of in-scope adversary techniques
Mandiant M-Trends 2024: median global dwell time reduced to 10 days, driven largely by EDR-enabled detection

controls.name: IAM Hardening (PAM, Least Privilege, JIT)
controls.description: Implements privileged access management, just-in-time elevation, role-based access reviews, and least-privilege enforcement to contain blast radius from compromised accounts.
sources: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 (AC-2, AC-6, IA-2): privileged access and least-privilege controls baseline
Forrester Wave PAM 2023: PAM deployments reduce privileged-account-related incidents by ~50%
Verizon DBIR 2024: misuse of privileges and credentials present in over 30% of breaches

controls.name: Security Awareness Training
controls.description: Phishing simulations, role-based modules, and reinforcement campaigns to reduce user susceptibility to social engineering, business email compromise, and unsafe data handling.
sources: Verizon DBIR 2024: the human element is involved in 68% of breaches; phishing remains a top initial vector
KnowBe4 Phishing by Industry Benchmarking Report 2024: phish-prone percentage drops from ~34% to ~5% after 12 months of training
Proofpoint State of the Phish 2024: organizations with mature training programs see 60%+ fewer successful phishing incidents

controls.name: Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM)
controls.description: Continuously assesses cloud accounts (AWS, Azure, GCP) for misconfigurations, exposed assets, and policy drift, and remediates against CIS Benchmarks and NIST 800-53 controls.
sources: Gartner Innovation Insight for CSPM: through 2025, 99% of cloud security failures will be the customer's fault, primarily misconfiguration
IBM X-Force Cloud Threat Landscape 2024: cloud misconfigurations cited in roughly two-thirds of cloud-environment breaches
NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 (CM-2, CM-6, CM-7): configuration management baseline for cloud workloads

controls.name: Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
controls.description: Classifies sensitive data and enforces policy on email, endpoint, and cloud egress channels to prevent accidental and malicious exfiltration of regulated or proprietary information.
sources: Ponemon Institute / IBM Cost of a Data Breach Report 2024: average cost of a data breach reached USD 4.88M, with exfiltration driving the largest cost component
Verizon DBIR 2024: miscellaneous errors and privilege misuse account for a significant share of confirmed data disclosure
NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 (SC-7, SI-4, AC-4): boundary protection and information flow enforcement controls
